name: RESAMPLE: a track, the main mix or USB recorded into RAM
description: A part of model27's builder, not a machine (notes/79, step R1): built once into resample.o by tools/gen_parts.py, added by tools/compose.py to a build when its card is ticked (compose.py --resample), with or without packages. The audio function's call of the mixer (0x40059872, jsr 0x400567ba) goes to the part's rs_mix: idle it jumps to the mixer; armed or recording it hands the chosen source to the recorder, a track's buffer before the mixer (after Volume + Dist and the Track FX, before level, pan and the sends), the main bus or the USB input after it. A take starts on the source's trigger (TRIG), its level (LEVEL, with the eight blocks before it) or at once (NOW), is kept in 32 bits in the RAM claim, and ends on RECORD, at its longest or after 250 ms of silence, the tail cut. 0.1 has no page yet: the UI side's functions (rs_arm, rs_stop, rs_cancel, rs_release, and for the save rs_header, rs_norm, rs_pcm16) are there for the page and the proofs.
